name: zclass_world_set_size
description: zClass_World::gwWorldSetSize stores the world X/Z extents and recomputes the max X/Z bounds from the current origin.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass world/source-cluster pass that includes the adjacent origin, partition, and grid setup helpers.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x450c30 validates the leaf world-data access through node->classData, stores sizeX and sizeZ, computes worldMaxX as originX + sizeX, computes worldMaxZ as originZ + sizeZ, returns 0, and has no direct callees.
The native smoke verifies stored X/Z sizes and recomputed max bounds from a non-zero origin.
